entities.summary: Jaime Jesús Echenique Salinas is a Colombian professional basketball player for Pallacanestro Reggiana of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A (LBA). He played college basketball for the Trinity Valley Community College Cardinals and the Wichita State Shockers.
